info.name: PCI Procurement & SPJ System API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for CV Pustaka Cemerlang Indonesia (PCI) Procurement & SPJ System.
Automates document lifecycle, financial calculations, validation (BR01-BR15), multi-format generation (XLSX, DOCX, PDF, ZIP), and artifact downloads.

item.name: 2. Excel Ingestion & Migration
item.description: Upload and parse existing multi-sheet Excel workbooks (e.g. 4 PCI KK09.xlsx), preview candidate items and detected invariant discrepancies, and confirm import into active package revisions.

request.description: Uploads .xlsx, computes SHA-256 hash, extracts transaction lines across D01-D13, detects formula anomalies, and returns candidate import ID.
Retrieves parsed candidate lines, school/company metadata, detected discrepancies (e.g., cross-sheet line item count or price mismatch), and readiness flag.
Confirms the candidate workbook, immutably snapshots masters, calculates exact financial sums and terbilang, allocates document sequences, and creates Package Revision 1.

item.description: CRUD and revision lifecycle management for procurement packages with optimistic concurrency locking.

Retrieves full revision snapshot, including lines, events, document numbers, and subtotal/grand_total.

item.name: 4. Deterministic Validation Engine (BR01 - BR15)
item.description: Deterministic multi-rule validator enforcing Indonesian procurement compliance rules (pricing monotonicity, date chronological ordering, tax rate consistency, signature validity).

request.description: Executes deterministic validation engine against revision data. Persists run results and individual findings.
Retrieves all findings from the latest validation run (errors, warnings, informational items).
Records justification and disposition for warning findings by Finance Director.

item.name: 5. Document Generation Engine
item.description: Asynchronous multi-format generation engine. Produces 1 consolidated link-free Excel (.xlsx), 13 individual Word documents (.docx), 13 printable PDF documents (.pdf), 1 merged master dossier (.pdf), and 1 ZIP packaging bundle.

request.description: Enqueues asynchronous job generating all 29 target artifacts. Applies DRAFT watermark if revision is in draft status.
Enqueues generation for specific format only (e.g. XLSX) for rapid export without rendering PDFs.
Polls status (QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED) and progress percentage (0-100%).

item.name: 6. Document Artifacts & Binary Downloads
item.description: Inspect generated artifacts manifest with SHA-256 integrity hashes and download binary files (.xlsx, .docx, .pdf, .zip).

request.description: Lists all 29 artifacts (or generated subset) for the package revision with file size, SHA-256 hash, and download URLs.
Streams binary artifact file with proper Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers (e.g. application/pdf, application/zip, etc.).

item.name: 6. Workflow & Approval Transitions
item.description: Enterprise state machine coordinating review, approval, withdrawal, return, final issuance, reopening, and cancellation under strict RBAC.

request.description: Submits a DRAFT revision for review. Requires validation to pass (BR01-BR15).
Withdraws revision back to DRAFT before review decision is rendered.
Reviewer returns revision with detailed comments for administrative revision.
Finance Director formal approval. Locks commercial pricing and unlocks logistics recording.

Performs final issuance: enforces BR13 logistics compliance, generates clean official documents without draft watermark, verifies BR14 export equivalence, updates package to ISSUED, marks predecessors SUPERSEDED, and registers Google Drive archive sync.
Reopens an ISSUED package by creating Revision N+1 in DRAFT while Rev N remains ISSUED until Rev N+1 is issued.
Cancels entire package. If DRAFT/RETURNED: Admin or Finance can cancel. If APPROVED/ISSUED: ONLY Finance Director can cancel.

item.name: 10. AI Assistance & Semantic Verification
item.description: Advisory AI engine for intelligent header mapping, cross-document semantic discrepancy auditing, PII sanitization, prompt injection defense, and budget guardrails with manual review fallback (PRD Milestone 5, FR02, FR05, AT16).

request.description: Examines non-standard uploaded spreadsheet, safely sanitizes PII, and returns candidate column mapping and header row index with confidence score.
Applies hybrid deterministic pre-filtering across revision items, passes suspect non-matching items to LLM, and ingests findings (WARNING/INFO) into the findings table.
Records manual review verification when AI is unavailable or budget cap is reached, permitting package submission to Under Review (PRD FR05 and AT16).
Returns current month token counts, estimated cumulative costs, remaining budget, and AI service status.
